description_en: Modifies the password that is used to log on to an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G device whose version is 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 修改SAG设备管理员密码，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag update-smart-access-gateway-admin-password --sag-ins-id sag-sv487b7lno6go50000 --sag-sn sagf4ea0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --password 12340000 --cross-account false --resource-uid 1473043827960000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSmartAccessGatewayAdminPassword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new password used to log on to the SAG device.

The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

> In the example, asterisks (\*) are used to conceal the real password. This does not mean that the password supports asterisks (\*). The actual format requirement prevails
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关设备新的登录密码。

密码格式要求：长度为8~30个字符，可包含大小写字母、数字和下划线（_）。

> 示例值中使用星号（*）以掩盖真实密码，不表示密码支持使用星号，输入密码时请以密码格式要求为准
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

- **false**（默认值）：否。

- **true**：是
